audit.why: Mirror (kassadin__volibear) settled the chart: levels 1-6 Volibear, first item Skill 5/10, two-plus items Kassadin 6/10 (so 4/10 from this side). The current chart already matches on both layers, so no side/rating flips are proposed. whys[0] contradicted its own row by calling level 1 even; corrected in prose only.
audit.corrected: Chart left as-is; whys[0] rewritten to agree with win[0]='Volibear'.

audit.whatIsWrong: Stormbringer was described as giving a shield elsewhere in the page family and the level-6 spike never used real numbers; Riftwalk's own cooldown (5s at rank 1) was never stated even though it is the whole reason the pre-6 window matters.
audit.why: Riot text: R gives bonus Health (not a shield), 160/135/110s, 550 range, and disables enemy towers near the landing point. Kassadin R is 5/3.5/2s, 500 range.
audit.corrected: Level-6 spike now states Riftwalk's 5s rank-1 cooldown, Stormbringer's bonus health, and the tower disable as the reason to dive rather than chase.

audit.whatIsWrong: Thundering Smash was repeatedly called a 'dash' and its CC called a 'root'. Riot's text says he gains speed toward enemies and Stuns the first one he Attacks — it is a run-down and the stun lands on the attack, not on the cast. Frenzied Maul's heal was never tied to the second cast on the same mark.
audit.why: A player told it is a dash will try to close blink-range gaps with it and will mistime the stun; Riftwalk beats a chase, not a blink-cancel. Frenzied Maul (5s, 325 range) marks on the first cast and only heals when re-cast into the same marked target.
audit.corrected: Q is a run-down whose stun lands on the next attack; Frenzied Maul heals only on the second bite into the same mark.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns named Riftwalk as the punishable cooldown, but a 5s blink is never a punish window.
audit.why: Force Pulse is 21s at rank 1, 400 range, and is his only slow — that is the cooldown worth waiting out before committing.
audit.corrected: Punish window moved to Force Pulse (E), 21s at rank 1.

audit.why: The 'channel' flag on Null Sphere is a tooltip-parse artefact of the phrase 'interrupting channels' in Kassadin's own description — Null Sphere is point-and-click and is not itself a channel. No cancel claim written, matching the mirror's decision.

edits.before: Bully him early — stun-engage on the Riftwalk cooldown and out-bite the brawl. Volibear wins by trading around Kassadin's Riftwalk and cashing the pattern: stun-engage on the Riftwalk cooldown and out-bite the brawl.
edits.after: Bully him early — Riftwalk is only a 5s blink at rank 1, so kill him before 6 rather than chasing it. Run him down with Thundering Smash, bite the same mark twice with Frenzied Maul for the heal, and deny his scaling clock.

edits.before: - Kassadin Riftwalk: matchup-defining — His mobility spike at 6. Kill him before it scales. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Riftwalk (R): 5s at rank 1, 500 range — the punishable window is Force Pulse (E), 21s at rank 1 and his only slow.

edits.before: Burning your answer for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: The second Frenzied Maul on a marked target is your heal — no mark, no sustain.

edits.before: Level 1 is even — neither has a real combo, just autos and positioning.
edits.after: Level 1 you win the auto war — Void Stone cuts magic damage, not your autos.

edits.before: At 2 your Q dash starts pinning the escape-less Kassadin.
edits.after: At 2 Thundering Smash runs him down and your next hit stuns.

edits.before: You crush early — Kassadin is helpless pre-6 against melee pressure, so land Q Thundering Smash root into W Frenzied Maul and take big chunks every wave to deny his scaling.
edits.after: You crush early — Kassadin is helpless pre-6, so run him down with Thundering Smash, stun on the attack, then Frenzied Maul twice on the same mark for the heal-bite and deny his scaling.

edits.before: His R Riftwalk unlocks escape, but your R Stormbringer plus Q root still lets you catch him before he blinks; kill him before he can stack Riftwalk mana cost cheaply.
edits.after: Riftwalk is a 5s blink at rank 1, so Stormbringer's leap and bonus health let you re-close; it disables his tower on landing, so dive him instead of chasing the blink.

edits.before: Land Q root and W him every wave to deny CS
edits.after: Land the Q stun and Maul him off the wave

edits.before: Dodge your Q dash with well-timed R
edits.after: Blink out before your Q stun connects
